articles.title: TINES AND OPENAI ON WHAT IT LEADERS NEED TO GET RIGHT IN 2027
articles.summary:
Your teams can build apps and automations with AI faster than ever. Keeping that work running takes more than the code, and IT is often left figuring out who owns it, which credentials it uses, and what it costs.

On November 18 [4], join Tines and Applied AI Architect from OpenAI for five predictions on what it will take to govern AI-built work in 2027 [4]:

> ESTABLISHING OWNERSHIP FOR AI-BUILT WORK: knowing who's accountable when the builder isn't IT.

> PREPARING FOR MAINTENANCE AND AUDIT DEMANDS: keeping pace as AI-built code outgrows IT's capacity.

> GIVING TEAMS A GOVERNED ENVIRONMENT: letting everyone keep building without creating blind spots.

articles.title: CHATGPT ENTERPRISE NOW AVAILABLE IN AWS MARKETPLACE
articles.summary: OpenAI has made ChatGPT Enterprise available through the AWS Marketplace, allowing organizations to purchase and manage the AI product using their existing AWS accounts and billing relationships. Customers gain access to the same models and features available directly from OpenAI while being able to apply eligible spend toward AWS commitments. Additionally, eligible customers can access specialized offerings such as ChatGPT for Healthcare and ChatGPT for Financial Services.

articles.title: MICROSOFT PRESSES TRUMP TO SCUTTLE BAN ON CHINESE DATA CENTER TECH
articles.summary: Microsoft and industry groups are lobbying against a proposed US ban on new Chinese optical transceivers used in data centers. They warn that alternative suppliers lack capacity to replace Chinese vendors, potentially delaying construction and leaving purchased AI chips idle. The restrictions are still under consideration.

articles.title: PANIC OVER CLOUD CAPACITY IS OUT OF HAND
articles.summary: Claims that AWS and other cloud providers have sold out of AI capacity through 2027 exaggerate infrastructure shortages and create unnecessary concern for enterprises. While GPU, power, and infrastructure constraints affect large-scale AI training, standard inference and fine-tuning workloads remain feasible. Enterprises should distinguish between workload types, verify capacity directly with cloud providers, and build flexible architectures rather than react to market hype.

articles.title: IT LEADERS SEEK ALTERNATIVES FOR SAP, VMWARE, AND JAVA
articles.summary: Licensing increases and support deadlines are prompting IT leaders to explore replacements for SAP, VMware, and Oracle Java. Executives warn that integrations, training, disruption, and parallel operations can outweigh license savings. They recommend pricing a realistic exit before negotiations and distinguishing dissatisfaction from a workable migration plan.

articles.summary: Ads get ignored on social media but not in TLDR! Reach IT pros and IT leaders where they actually pay attention. Learn more about sponsorship opportunities [9].

articles.title: CISCO AI DEFENSE TO ADD ANTHROPIC'S CLAUDE MYTHOS FOR AI RED TEAMING
articles.summary: Cisco is integrating Anthropic's Claude Mythos model into its AI Defense platform to enhance adaptive red teaming for enterprise AI agents. The integration is designed to help enterprises identify security vulnerabilities and behavioral risks in agentic AI applications through controlled, authorized testing.

articles.title: EXPANDING GEMINI IN GMAIL TO MORE GOOGLE WORKSPACE USERS
articles.summary: Google is expanding email-thread summaries and non-personalized Help me write to all Workspace users aged 18 or older with Gmail smart features enabled. These features are on by default, with user and admin controls to disable them. Rollout began on November 10 and could take up to 15 days.

articles.title: APPTIO EXPANDS PORTFOLIO TO HELP ENTERPRISES CONNECT AI SPENDING TO BUSINESS VALUE
articles.summary: IBM expanded Apptio's AI spending tools and Kubecost's Kubernetes network-cost reporting. Available capabilities include AI usage connectors, financial planning for AI services, and more detailed AWS NAT Gateway, cross-zone, and cross-region cost visibility. The announcement also covers planned MCP servers and scenario-planning features, so availability varies across the portfolio.

articles.title: USE DOCKER SANDBOXES AS YOUR DEVELOPMENT ENVIRONMENT
articles.summary: Docker Sandboxes provide isolated microVM-based development environments for building software projects, such as books using Pandoc and XeLaTeX, without cluttering the host system. Developers can use the sbx CLI to create sandboxes, configure network policies, and install necessary toolchains and dependencies. They can also preserve and reproduce these environments through snapshots or declarative Dockerfiles.

articles.title: ROYAL AUSTRALASIAN COLLEGE OF SURGEONS TARGETS AU$2.1 MILLION IN SAVINGS WITH HPE PRIVATE CLOUD
articles.summary: HPE says RACS lowered its virtualization licensing bill by as much as 70% and reduced its fleet from eight servers to four. The migration followed a renewal quote that was roughly 300% higher. RACS projects a total AU$2.1 million benefit over five years, including planned infrastructure and disaster recovery improvements.

articles.title: ANTHROPIC AND OPENAI ARE COMING FOR THE DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW
articles.summary: Frontier AI labs like Anthropic and OpenAI are increasingly expanding their functionality to control more of the end-to-end software development workflow in order to maximize profitability and extend the commercial value of their models.

articles.title: AMAZON CLOUDWATCH LOGS ANNOUNCES ACCOUNT-LEVEL RETENTION POLICIES
articles.summary: CloudWatch now supports account-wide or prefix-based retention policies for log groups.

articles.title: AMAZON ROUTE 53 PROFILES NOW SUPPORTS MULTIPLE PROFILES PER VPC
articles.summary: Multiple Route 53 Profiles can now attach to one VPC, letting teams manage separate DNS configurations with explicit priorities.
